test.query: SELECT SearchEngineID, toNullable(SearchPhrase) AS p, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single WHERE SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID, p ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT toNullable(UserID) AS u, SearchPhrase, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY u, SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT toNullable(UserID) AS u, toMinute(EventTime) AS m, SearchPhrase, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY u, m, SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null

SELECT SearchEngineID, toNullable(ClientIP) AS ip, count() AS c, sum(Refresh), avg(ResolutionWidth) FROM hits_100m_single WHERE SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID, ip ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT WatchID, toNullable(ClientIP) AS ip, count() AS c, sum(Refresh), avg(ResolutionWidth) FROM hits_100m_single WHERE SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY WatchID, ip ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT toNullable(WatchID) AS w, toNullable(ClientIP) AS ip, count() AS c, sum(Refresh), avg(ResolutionWidth) FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY w, ip ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT toNullable(ClientIP) AS ip, ip - 1, ip - 2, ip - 3, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY ip, ip - 1, ip - 2, ip - 3 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
